parsed.post: Discarding the DEPTH=8 experiment (val_bpb 1.105827) as it performed worse than our current best. Reverting to DEPTH=6 (commit 2d763e6, val_bpb 1.061423). It seems increasing depth without adjusting batch size or learning rate slows convergence too much for the 5-minute window. Moving to fine-tune hyperparameters for DEPTH=6.
parsed.description: Reverting to DEPTH=6 and testing a higher MATRIX_LR (0.15) combined with increased WEIGHT_DECAY (0.05) to improve convergence speed and regularization.
